purpose: Teach: 版画/トランク/牡蠣/酒場/風呂敷/ヒーター/白髪/笹

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、版画の展覧会のお話されてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: A customer was telling me about a woodblock print exhibition.
lines.style: Gentle and observant, like sharing something someone noticed. Warm tone, easy pace. Soft eye contact—she's drawing Aoi into the moment they shared with the customer.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、新しい食材、トランクで配達されたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: New ingredients came in today, delivered in a trunk.
lines.style: Simple, matter-of-fact delivery. A small smile in the voice—noticing the charm of it. Quiet, conversational pace. Glancing up from what she's doing.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、冬限定で牡蠣のメニュー作りましょう、メイちゃん
lines.en: Should we make a winter-only oyster menu?
lines.style: Brighter opening, more engaged. A spark of creative excitement. Leaning forward slightly in posture. Quick, animated pace with a natural lift at the end—it's an invitation.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お友達と酒場で乾杯したいって、メイちゃん
lines.en: A customer mentioned wanting to toast with friends at an izakaya.
lines.style: Wistful and observant, like noticing something in passing. Quieter register. Slight smile underneath—aware of the simple joy in that wish. Steady, reflective pace.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、風呂敷でお買い物していらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: I saw a customer shopping with a furoshiki today.
lines.style: Appreciative and gentle. A quiet delight in the detail. Measured pace, like she's savoring the image. Soft voice, almost like thinking out loud to someone trusted.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、寒くなってきたから、新しいヒーター入れたいね、メイちゃん
lines.en: The cold's setting in—we should probably get a new heater.
lines.style: Practical with a hint of warmth. Opening word steady and clear. Conversational, no rush. A gentle suggestion, not a demand. Collaborative tone—'we.'

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、白髪が素敵で渋いね、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer has such distinguished silver hair.
lines.style: Admiring and soft. A moment of genuine appreciation. Slower pace, voice full of warmth. Lingers slightly on the beauty of the observation—no hurry to move on.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お正月飾りに笹を飾りましょう、メイちゃん
lines.en: Let's put bamboo leaves on the New Year decorations.
lines.style: Gentle, matter-of-fact direction. A soft, quiet tone—not commanding, but warmly collaborative. Close and intimate, like speaking to someone beside her. Small, natural smile.
